summary: War of the Ring is a big asymmetric wargame where one side commands Sauron's armies pushing across Middle-earth while the other secretly guides the Ring-bearer toward Mount Doom and rallies Free People nations to resist. Every turn is a tense card-driven balancing act between fighting open battles and protecting the fragile, hidden quest that is the Free Peoples' only real hope.
praised: outstanding asymmetric tension between military and hidden quest
action-die and event-card system that creates hard strategic choices
criticised: long playtime and heavy rules overhead
needs a dedicated 2-4 player group who commit to a full session
the 4-player team variant can create imbalance between teammates

interaction.kind: open military conflict and hidden information tension
interaction.detail: Free Peoples and Shadow directly battle over a shared map of regions and strongholds, while the Ring-bearer's secret movement and the political track create asymmetric information both sides are constantly reading and reacting to; almost all game state is shared and contested.

scoring.why: Victory is decided by two parallel asymmetric tracks — Shadow's military conquest of Free People strongholds/cities versus the Fellowship's secret progress toward destroying the Ring — rather than by accumulating points.
scoring.how_you_win: As Shadow you win by capturing enough Free People cities and strongholds; as the Free Peoples you win by sneaking the Ring-bearer to Mount Doom before Shadow achieves military conquest or the Ring is corrupted.

similar: A Game of Thrones: The Board Game
_name: War of the Ring: Second Edition
